title: Year One Owner vs Year Ten Owner

scenes.say: Same cafe. Year one and year ten look nothing alike.
Year one, Roma Tom worked every shift, seven days a week. Year ten, four days, and home for dinner.
Ten years taught him what to stop. Saying yes to every idea. Answering texts at midnight. And the big one: doing every job himself.

scenes.speaker: Dev
scenes.say: Year one, he checked every plate I made. Now he lets me run the line.

props.name: Dev
props.quote: Now he lets me *run the line*.

scenes.say: Which year are you in? Follow for more cafe life.
